tailored_resume:
Jane Doe
jane@example.com | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/janedoe

Software Engineer

Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience building and maintaining Python backend systems. Proficient in FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs, with hands-on expertise in Docker, Redis, and AWS. Proven ability to write unit tests and deliver reliable, scalable backend services across the full development lifecycle.

EXPERIENCE
Software Engineer, Acme Corp (2022-2024)
- Built and maintained REST APIs using Python and FastAPI, deploying backend services on AWS infrastructure.
- Managed PostgreSQL databases, orchestrated async task queues with Celery, and wrote unit tests to ensure reliability.
- Deployed services with Docker and integrated Redis for caching, improving API response times across distributed environments.

SKILLS
Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, REST APIs, Redis, Celery, AWS

change_log.description: Set resume header title to exact JD title: 'Software Engineer'.
Added a 3-sentence summary under 80 words starting with 'Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience', weaving in Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Docker, Redis, AWS, and unit tests.

Updated bullet 'Built REST APIs using Python and FastAPI' to 'Built and maintained REST APIs using Python and FastAPI, deploying backend services on AWS infrastructure.' — inserted AWS and aligned with JD responsibility 'build and maintain APIs'.
Updated bullet 'Managed PostgreSQL databases and wrote unit tests' to include Celery as an async task queue orchestration tool alongside PostgreSQL and unit tests.
Updated bullet 'Deployed services with Docker' to include Redis for caching, contextually paired with Docker-based deployment.
Added Redis, Celery, and AWS to the Skills section to match all inserted keywords.

keyword_insertions.new_bullet_text: Managed PostgreSQL databases, orchestrated async task queues with Celery, and wrote unit tests to ensure reliability.
